title: Rumored tunnels and cave system under mesa

tellings.quote: material. It was because there were rumors going back to the the big blow era and even before, going back to the Mayans, that there was a cave system,

plain: A cave system and tunnels are rumored to lie under the mesa at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange happenings. The ranch's owner tells Michels that the rumors go back to earlier owners of the ranch "and even before, going back to the Mayans," and that this is why material from the mesa was examined. If true, it would mean something hidden lies under the land at the center of the ranch's mysteries.
